title: Transfer of parameter-a.e. properties to H^n-a.e. points of a set covered by Lipschitz pieces
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P Borel, F_i : ℝ^n → ℝ^P (i ∈ ℕ) Lipschitz maps, and B_i ⊆ ℝ^n arbitrary sets with H^n(M ∖ ⋃_i F_i(B_i)) = 0, where H^n = μHE[n]. Let p be any property of points of ℝ^P such that, for every i, p(F_i(b)) holds for Lebesgue-a.e. b ∈ B_i (∀ᵐ b ∂(volume⌞B_i)). Then p(x) holds for H^n-a.e. x ∈ M (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n]⌞M)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (F : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (p : Euclid P → Prop), MeasurableSet M → (∀ i, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (F i)) → μHE[n] (M \ ⋃ i, F i '' B i) = 0 → (∀ i, ∀ᵐ b ∂(volume.restrict (B i)), p (F i b)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), p x
